diff --git a/python/archive_path/archive_path.py b/python/archive_path/archive_path.py
index c5363ee..d3825ed 100644
--- a/python/archive_path/archive_path.py
+++ b/python/archive_path/archive_path.py
@@ -1,2 +1,36 @@
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
 def safe_archive_path(root, member_name):
-    return root / member_name
+    """Return a Path under root for extracting an archive member safely.
+
+    Performs purely lexical validation of member_name (no filesystem access)
+    to reject path traversal, absolute paths, Windows drive letters,
+    backslashes, empty components, and NUL bytes.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(member_name, str):
+        raise ValueError(f"Archive member name must be a string: {member_name!r}")
+
+    if "\0" in member_name:
+        raise ValueError(f"Archive member name contains a NUL byte: {member_name!r}")
+
+    if "\\" in member_name:
+        raise ValueError(f"Archive member name contains a backslash: {member_name!r}")
+
+    if member_name.startswith("/"):
+        raise ValueError(f"Archive member name is an absolute path: {member_name!r}")
+
+    if len(member_name) >= 2 and member_name[1] == ":":
+        raise ValueError(f"Archive member name contains a drive letter: {member_name!r}")
+
+    if not member_name:
+        raise ValueError("Archive member name must not be empty")
+
+    parts = member_name.split("/")
+    for part in parts:
+        if part == "":
+            raise ValueError(f"Archive member name contains an empty path component: {member_name!r}")
+        if part == "..":
+            raise ValueError(f"Archive member name contains a path traversal component: {member_name!r}")
+
+    return Path(root) / member_name
